S.FORM: alang Tpuqu ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Syurin go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 155 buwan, 543 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 521 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 22 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Truku83%, Tayan4%, Amis2%, binah lihuyan s'uli 6%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Tpuqu hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Tpuqu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Tpuqu hya' ga bsilung. tay mkraya' na Tpuqu hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Tpuqu hya' ga Tkijig. tay mkyahu' na Tpuqu hya' ga Bsuring. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tpuqu ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu [s|ɕ]jurin ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa truku** tajan* ami[s|ɕ]* βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na tpuqu ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na tpuqu ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na tpuqu ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj mkrajaʔ na tpuqu ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na tpuqu ħjaʔ ɣa tkijiɣ taj mkjaħuʔ na tpuqu ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]uriŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
